capsule.format: Deterministic data-only ZIP, repacked from the two original JSON members; NOT the original Actions archive.

data_rights.exclusions: Article text, images and third-party content are not included or relicensed.

limitations: Historical selected six-series experiment, not live or representative coverage.
No raw HTTP response bodies are retained; their reported SHA-256 values cannot be independently recomputed from normalized rows.
No stable page_id observations are present; no cross-snapshot identity continuity or title-only stitching is established.
No site deployment or external user study is implied.
The source run predates the later Content-Length guard; response-body completeness is reported by that collector, not independently verified from raw bodies here.

source.recovery: Exact JSON members recovered from the retained owner-provided source handoff. The original Actions ZIP download/digest verification was performed in the earlier run, not repeated at adoption.
